def longestIncreasingStreak (nums : List Int) (h_precond : longestIncreasingStreak_precond (nums)) : Nat :=
  match nums with
  | [] => 0
  | x :: xs =>
    let rec compute (acc : Nat) (currentLen : Nat) (lst : List Int) : Nat :=
      match lst with
      | [] => acc + currentLen
      | y :: ys =>
        if currentLen = 0 then
          compute acc 1 ys
        else if x < y then
          compute acc (currentLen + 1) ys
        else
          compute (acc + currentLen) 1 ys
    compute 0 1 xs
